name: Westfield Century City
description: Westfield Century City is a premier upscale shopping destination in West Los Angeles featuring luxury retailers, award-winning dining, and world-class entertainment including an AMC Theatre. The open-air center showcases iconic brands like Tiffany & Co., Nordstrom, Bloomingdale's, and Eataly alongside emerging contemporary retailers like Alo Yoga, Aritzia, and UNIQLO. With its modern architectural design and extensive amenities including EV charging and seasonal entertainment, it offers a sophisticated shopping experience in the heart of Century City.
demographics: Affluent urban and suburban shoppers in West Los Angeles, high-income professionals, entertainment industry workers, and tourists visiting Beverly Hills and West LA area
summary: An upscale open-air regional shopping center in West Los Angeles featuring luxury brands, celebrity chef dining, and contemporary retail experiences.
